title: The 12:00: a note-taker, then what Monday needs
detail: The last stand-up before the summit. No decision has been recorded in 24 hours, and Saturday left no record. (1) Name a note-taker in the first minute. (2) Before Monday's collection: the garment files and Jose's navy (WS-48, Dinis and Silvio, carried 5 times), the outreach claim so Silvio can send (WS-26, Dinis). (3) Stand-ups through the summit (the decision item). (4) Parking the late, unowned issues: 135 late, 84 unowned, list ready since Friday; Vicky and Dinis, yes or no (recommended: yes). (5) WS-170 tokens per agent, then WS-09, WS-107 (recommended: option 2), WS-125. With Dinis, no decision needed today: Angelo's back-office proposal (WS-180). Say each as 'decided: <item>: <words>'.
